pages.title: Big hook: data/butchering
pages.text: Fields: $(thing)input$() (the hung item) and $(thing)stages$() (processed in order). Each stage:$(br)$(li)$(thing)tool$(): optional required knife; omit to allow any knife$(br)$(li)$(thing)name$(): prompt text$(br)$(li)$(thing)model$(): display model on the hook$(br)$(li)$(thing)drops$(): item ids produced by this stage; repeat an id to drop several

pages.title: Board: data/choppingboard_mob
pages.text: Fields: $(thing)input$(), $(thing)entity$() (used for rendering), $(thing)render$() and $(thing)stages$().$(br2)$(thing)render$() accepts $(thing)scale$(), $(thing)yaw$(), $(thing)y_offset$(), $(thing)roll$(), $(thing)x_offset$() and $(thing)z_offset$() to pose the fish.$(br2)Each $(thing)stages$() item has $(thing)name$() and $(thing)drops$(), e.g. scale / gut / cut, where the last stage drops segments and organs.

pages.title: Basin wash: data/basin_wash
pages.text: Fields: $(thing)input$(), $(thing)output$() (main result), $(thing)drops$() (extra drops) and $(thing)name$() (prompt name).$(br2)Example: washing silkworm cocoons yields silk and an extra raw silkworm chrysalis.

pages.title: Appraisal: data/appraisal_supplement
pages.text: Simplest format: $(thing){"source item id": ["extra result id", ...]}$().$(br2)When the source item is appraised, the listed items join the appraisal pool — used to add this mod's fruits to vanilla wild plants.$(br2)Example: add pomelo to the temperate wild fruit appraisal.
